C0187.title: Keqiao Police Dismantle 'Live Stream Idle Viewer Farming' Part-Time Job Scam
C0187.summary: In 2017, police in Keqiao, Zhejiang Province, cracked a part-time job scam disguised as 'farming viewer numbers for live streams.' The syndicate lured victims with promises of high returns, collecting referral fees and deposits, with total illicit proceeds exceeding 6 million yuan.
